bar.label: Compare record
bar.move: Move the bar: drag it, or use the arrow keys. Double-click puts it back.

guide.title: How to compare
guide.intro: The same record in three forms. Switch between them with the bar at the bottom and try the same thing in each. This is demo data: touch anything.
guide.question: Which one makes it quicker to understand what a change affects, without getting lost in the record?
guide.move_hint: If the bar covers something, drag it by the handle on its left. Double-click the handle to put it back.

a.what: Today’s record. The index on the left works as tabs: it shows one section and hides the rest.
a.step1: Click a few sections in the index on the left.
a.step2: Change something in one section and move to another: what you touched is no longer visible.
a.look: It is the baseline: compare the other two against it.
a.summary: Today’s: one section at a time.

b.what: The May version: every section one after another on a single page. The index hides nothing: it takes you to the section and marks where you are.

agent.step1: Click “Permissions” in the index: the page scrolls to that section.

group.step1: Click “Assigned agents” in the index: the page scrolls to that section.

user.step1: Click “Access” in the index: the page scrolls to that section.

b.step2: Scroll up and down: the index marks the section in front of you.
b.step3: Change something and keep scrolling: the rest of the record stays in view.
b.look: Whether seeing everything together helps you understand what you touch, or whether there is so much that you get lost.
b.summary: Everything on one page; the index takes you there.

e.what: The whole record as full-width summary cards. Click “Edit” on one and its settings open in a panel on the right; the record moves aside to make room, so you see the summary while you edit.

agent.step1: Click “Edit” on the “Identification” card: its settings open in a panel on the right.
agent.step2: Turn off “Active”: the card on the left shows it straight away.

group.step1: Click “Edit” on the “Channels and strategy” card.
group.step2: Untick “Phone”: in the “Assigned agents” card the agents lose phone straight away.

user.step2: Untick “Statistics”: the card shows it straight away.

e.step3: Click outside the panel, the X or Esc to close it: the record takes the full width again.
e.look: Whether keeping the summary in view while you edit in the panel is enough to understand what each change affects.
e.summary: Full-width summary; settings in a panel when you click Edit.
